title.value: Ageism and Artificial Intelligence: Protocol for a Scoping Review
title.justification: The paper focuses on establishing a scoping review protocol related to ageism within artificial intelligence systems.
title.quote: Ageism and Artificial Intelligence: Protocol for a Scoping Review

extractions.description: This paper outlines a scoping review protocol to explore how age-related biases are encoded or amplified in AI systems. It also examines the societal, legal, and ethical implications of such biases. The review will be conducted by searching multiple databases for relevant literature, analyzing the data, and disseminating findings to stakeholders. The ultimate goal is to provide insights into the extent of digital ageism and encourage multisectoral cooperation to address it.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The focus of the paper is primarily on understanding age-related biases in AI rather than directly addressing climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a major driver of technological development in the 21st century, yet little attention has been paid to algorithmic biases toward older adults.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on climate or ecological sustainable development but instead on digital ageism within AI systems, which falls outside the predefined categories for climate and ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: Objective: This paper documents the search strategy and process for a scoping review exploring how age-related bias is encoded or amplified in AI systems as well as the corresponding legal and ethical implications.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no climate or ecological sustainable development themes addressed in the paper beyond ageism in AI.
secondary_categories.quote: Results: The findings will provide interdisciplinary insights into the extent of age-related bias in AI systems.

primary_sub_category.justification: The subject area of ageism and AI bias is not related to any specific sub-category within sustainable development in climate or ecology.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...how age-related bias is encoded or amplified in AI systems...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Focus is exclusively on age-related bias in AI, which does not pertain to any additional climate/ecological sub-categories.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: What is known about age-related bias in AI technology?
